verses.en: Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
verses.pt: Tu, pois, meu filho, fortifica-te na graça que há em Cristo Jesus;
verses.en_web: You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: So then, my child, be strong in the grace which is in Christ Jesus.

verses.en: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.
verses.pt: e o que de mim ouviste de muitas testemunhas, transmite-o a homens fiéis, que sejam idôneos para também ensinarem os outros.
verses.en_web: The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same to faithful men, who will be able to teach others also.
verses.en_bbe: And the things which I have said to you before a number of witnesses, give to those of the faith, so that they may be teachers of others.

verses.en: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.
verses.pt: Sofre comigo como bom soldado de Cristo Jesus.
verses.en_web: You therefore must endure hardship, as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: Be ready to do without the comforts of life, as one of the army of Christ Jesus.

verses.en: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.
verses.pt: Nenhum soldado em serviço se embaraça com negócios desta vida, a fim de agradar àquele que o alistou para a guerra.
verses.en_web: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.
verses.en_bbe: A fighting man, when he is with the army, keeps himself free from the business of this life so that he may be pleasing to him who has taken him into his army.

verses.en: And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.
verses.pt: E também se um atleta lutar nos jogos públicos, não será coroado se não lutar legitimamente.
verses.en_web: Also, if anyone competes in athletics, he isn’t crowned unless he has competed by the rules.
verses.en_bbe: And if a man takes part in a competition he does not get the crown if he has not kept the rules.

verses.en: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits.
verses.pt: O lavrador que trabalha deve ser o primeiro a gozar dos frutos.
verses.en_web: The farmer who labors must be the first to get a share of the crops.
verses.en_bbe: It is right for the worker in the fields to be the first to take of the fruit.

verses.en: Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.
verses.pt: Considera o que digo, porque o Senhor te dará entendimento em tudo.
verses.en_web: Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.
verses.en_bbe: Give thought to what I say; for the Lord will give you wisdom in all things.

verses.en: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:
verses.pt: Lembra-te de Jesus Cristo, ressurgido dentre os mortos, descendente de Davi, segundo o meu evangelho,
verses.en_web: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the offspring of David, according to my Good News,
verses.en_bbe: Keep in mind Jesus Christ, of the seed of David, who came back from the dead, as my good news gives witness:

verses.en: Wherein I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds; but the word of God is not bound.
verses.pt: pelo qual sofro a ponto de ser preso como malfeitor; mas a palavra de Deus não está presa.
verses.en_web: in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God’s word isn’t chained.
verses.en_bbe: In which I put up with the hardest conditions, even prison chains, like one who has done a crime; but the word of God is not in chains.

verses.en: Therefore I endure all things for the elect’s sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
verses.pt: Por isso, tudo suporto por amor dos eleitos, para que também eles alcancem a salvação que há em Cristo Jesus com glória eterna.
verses.en_web: Therefore I endure all things for the chosen ones’ sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
verses.en_bbe: But I undergo all things for the saints, so that they may have salvation in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

verses.en: It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him, we shall also live with him:
verses.pt: Fiel é esta palavra: Se, pois, já morremos com ele, também com ele viveremos;
verses.en_web: This saying is trustworthy: “For if we died with him, we will also live with him.
verses.en_bbe: This is a true saying: If we undergo death with him, then will we be living with him:

verses.en: If we suffer, we shall also reign with him: if we deny him, he also will deny us:
verses.pt: se perseveramos, com ele também reinaremos; se o negarmos, também ele nos negará;
verses.en_web: If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.
verses.en_bbe: If we go on to the end, then we will be ruling with him: if we say we have no knowledge of him, then he will say he has no knowledge of us:

verses.en: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.
verses.pt: se somos infiéis, ele permanece fiel; porque não pode negar-se a si mesmo.
verses.en_web: If we are faithless, he remains faithful. For he can’t deny himself.”
verses.en_bbe: If we are without faith, still he keeps faith, for he will never be untrue to himself.

verses.en: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.
verses.pt: Lembra-lhes estas coisas, conjurando-os diante de Deus que não tenham contendas de palavras, que para nada aproveitam, senão para subverter os ouvintes.
verses.en_web: Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord, that they don’t argue about words, to no profit, to the subverting of those who hear.
verses.en_bbe: Put these things before them, giving them orders in the name of the Lord to keep themselves from fighting about words, which is of no profit, only causing error in their hearers.

verses.en: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.
verses.pt: Procura apresentar-te diante de Deus aprovado, como obreiro que não tem de que se envergonhar, que maneja bem a palavra da verdade.
verses.en_web: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.
verses.en_bbe: Let it be your care to get the approval of God, as a workman who has no cause for shame, giving the true word in the right way.

verses.en: But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.
verses.pt: Mas evita as conversas vãs e profanas; porque os que delas usam passarão a impiedade ainda maior,
verses.en_web: But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,
verses.en_bbe: But take no part in wrong and foolish talk, for those who do so will go farther into evil,

verses.en: And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus;
verses.pt: e as suas palavras alastrarão como gangrena; entre os quais estão Himeneu e Fileto,
verses.en_web: and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus;
verses.en_bbe: And their words will be like poisoned wounds in the flesh: such are Hymenaeus and Philetus;

verses.en: Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.
verses.pt: que se desviaram da verdade, dizendo que a ressurreição é já passada, e assim pervertem a fé a alguns.
verses.en_web: men who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and overthrowing the faith of some.
verses.en_bbe: Men whose ideas are all false, who say that the coming back from the dead has even now taken place, overturning the faith of some.

verses.en: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.
verses.pt: Todavia o firme fundamento de Deus permanece, tendo este selo: O Senhor conhece os seus, e: Aparte-se da injustiça todo aquele que profere o nome do Senhor.
verses.en_web: However God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal, “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.”
verses.en_bbe: But God's strong base is unchanging, having this sign, The Lord has knowledge of those who are his: and, Let everyone by whom the name of the Lord is named be turned away from evil.

verses.en: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.
verses.pt: Ora, numa grande casa, não somente há vasos de ouro e de prata, mas também de madeira e de barro; e uns, na verdade, para uso honroso, outros, porém, para uso desonroso.
verses.en_web: Now in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of clay. Some are for honor, and some for dishonor.
verses.en_bbe: Now in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and silver, but others of wood and earth, and some which are honoured and some without honour.

verses.en: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master’s use, and prepared unto every good work.
verses.pt: Se, pois, alguém se purificar destas coisas, será vaso para honra, santificado e útil ao Senhor, preparado para toda boa obra.
verses.en_web: If anyone therefore purges himself from these, he will be a vessel for honor, sanctified, and suitable for the master’s use, prepared for every good work.
verses.en_bbe: If a man makes himself clean from these, he will be a vessel for honour, made holy, ready for the master's use, ready for every good work.

verses.en: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
verses.pt: Foge também das paixões da mocidade, e segue a justiça, a fé, o amor, a paz com os que, de coração puro, invocam o Senhor.
verses.en_web: Flee from youthful lusts; but pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
verses.en_bbe: But keep yourself from those desires of the flesh which are strong when the body is young, and go after righteousness, faith, love, peace, with those whose prayers go up to the Lord from a clean heart.

verses.en: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.
verses.pt: E rejeita as questões tolas e desassisadas, sabendo que geram contendas;
verses.en_web: But refuse foolish and ignorant questionings, knowing that they generate strife.
verses.en_bbe: And put away foolish and uncontrolled questionings, seeing that they are a cause of trouble.

verses.en: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,
verses.pt: e ao servo do Senhor não convém contender, mas sim ser brando para com todos, apto para ensinar, paciente;
verses.en_web: The Lord’s servant must not quarrel, but be gentle towards all, able to teach, patient,
verses.en_bbe: For it is not right for the Lord's servant to make trouble, but he is to be gentle to all, ready in teaching, putting up with wrong,

verses.en: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;
verses.pt: corrigindo com mansidão os que resistem, na esperança de que Deus lhes conceda o arrependimento para conhecerem plenamente a verdade,
verses.en_web: in gentleness correcting those who oppose him: perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the truth,
verses.en_bbe: Gently guiding those who go against the teaching; if by chance God may give them a change of heart and true knowledge,

verses.en: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.
verses.pt: e que se desprendam dos laços do Diabo (por quem haviam sido presos), para cumprirem a vontade de Deus.
verses.en_web: and they may recover themselves out of the devil’s snare, having been taken captive by him to his will.
verses.en_bbe: And so they may get themselves free from the net of the Evil One, being made the prisoners of the Lord's servant, for the purpose of God.
